description: This file defines a class 'OpenmrsDateFormat' that extends 'SimpleDateFormat' to provide customized date parsing with additional validation to ensure dates conform to specific formats, primarily focusing on the year part to prevent misinterpretation of two-digit years.

classes.name: OpenmrsDateFormat
classes.description: An extension of SimpleDateFormat that defaults to setLenient(false) and adds date validation to prevent incorrect interpretation of date years, especially focusing on enforcing four-digit years and matching pattern length with input string.

methods.name: OpenmrsDateFormat
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OpenmrsDateFormat with a given SimpleDateFormat and Locale, sets leniency to false.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Overrides the parse method to include custom validation: it checks if the pattern ends with 'yyyy' and ensures the input string ends with four digits; otherwise, it verifies that the string length matches the pattern length before parsing.
